assessment_scope: Engineer judgment supporting the manuscript's dualizing/discrepancy/lower-genus remark and the old report's additional genus window and stabilization by 5C, conditional on the actual proper analytic contraction and the stated curve section counts. No exact genus, earliest stabilization, infinite-jet convergence, novelty, or family acceptance is certified.

source_version.manuscript: A singular normal affine surface with free tangent sheaf
source_version.attribution: The manuscript states trivial dualizing sheaf, discrepancy -5 and p_g>=33. The old Argus report adds the upper bound 39 and stabilization by 5C. These strengthenings are not certified as novel.

imported_hypotheses: pi:Y->X is a proper contraction from a smooth Hausdorff complex surface to a normal isolated surface singularity, biholomorphic off its entire reduced exceptional fiber C, with pi_*O_Y=O_X.
C is smooth connected, g(C)=21 and C^2=-10. For I=O_Y(-C) and L=I/I^2, deg(L)=10 and L^4=K_C.
The curve-trace input supplies h0(C,L)=2 and h0(C,L^2)=3; these do not follow from the numerical genus and degree alone.
The actual lifted fields have ordinary wedge t^5 u(t,z) d/dt wedge d/dz, with u a unit on one common neighborhood, and descend to a frame on X minus {x}.
For J=m_x O_Y, a single a>=1 satisfies I^a subset J subset I along all C, and hence I^(ar) subset J^r subset I^r for every r>=1.

claim_assessments.reason: The actual punctured frame supplies a nowhere-zero holomorphic two-form. The exact Flenner-Zaidenberg v1 normal-surface paragraph gives trivial dualizing sheaf and Gorensteinness. Its actual dual-wedge pullback has divisor -5C, so with K_X=0 the discrepancy is -5, agreeing with adjunction K_Y.C=50. Constants lift on the double curve, giving h1(O_(2C))=12+21=33; formal functions transfers the bound to p_g and the one-vertex graph gives p_g-g-b>=12.
claim_assessments.historical_changes: v1 is the manuscript remark with no annotated external input and a provenance warning that it is not independently verified. v2 records AN_surface_dualizing at Definition 2.18 and the following paragraph of arXiv:math/0109221v1, not the restrictive Theorem 2.20. The mathematical statement is unchanged.

claim_assessments.reason: The scalar graded H1 dimensions are 21,12,3,2,1,0, with vanishing for all n>=5. The first connecting map is zero because constants lift; later increments are at most 3,2,1, giving 33<=h1(O_(5C))<=39 without assuming later connecting maps vanish. All transitions from n+1 to n are isomorphisms for n>=5. Explicit two-sided cofinal maps compare the I- and J-adic limits, and proper coherence, formal functions and finite-length completion identify the actual R1 stalk with H1(O_(5C)) as complex vector spaces.
historical_changes: v1 states the vector-space identification, window and stabilization by 5C.
v2 adds the corrected Grauert completed-stalk formal-functions proposition.
v4 adds proper direct-image coherence for the finite-length/completion step.
claim_assessments.quantifier_boundary: Stabilization is proved for every transition n+1 -> n with n>=5. It is not asserted that 5C is the earliest stabilization point.

cross_unit_claim_assessments.reason: The logarithmic field sequence has outer terms L^n and L^(n-4), so its two dual obstruction bundles are L^(4-n) and L^(8-n). Vanishing holds for all n>=9; the n=8 group is one-dimensional. This field threshold is distinct from scalar stabilization by 5C.
Its invariant components are precisely those proved here. AN_genus_window is needed explicitly for the additional upper bound 39.

external_assumptions.statement: A normal surface singularity is Cohen-Macaulay, and is Gorenstein with dualizing module isomorphic to its local ring if and only if a punctured neighborhood admits a nowhere-vanishing holomorphic two-form.
external_assumptions.source_version: Flenner and Zaidenberg, Rational curves and rational singularities, v1, 28 September 2001
external_assumptions.locator: Section 2.4, Definition 2.18 and following paragraph, printed p.19
external_assumptions.read_assessment: Read the archived primary-page text and the relevant paragraph/context of full v1. The local paragraph is unrestricted by a good C*-action; Theorem 2.20 has additional affine/good-action hypotheses and is not used. The actual punctured frame supplies the required form.

external_assumptions.statement: A Noetherian normal ring satisfies R1 and S2; a normal local domain of dimension two has depth two and hence is Cohen-Macaulay.
external_assumptions.locator: Tag 031S, Lemma 10.157.4, Normal equals R1 plus S2
external_assumptions.read_assessment: Read the archived proposition and explicit depth consequence. The application is to the Noetherian analytic local domain, not a purported algebraic-to-analytic Hartogs import.

external_assumptions.statement: For a holomorphic line bundle B on a smooth compact complex curve C, H^1(C,B) is dual to H^0(C,K_C tensor B^-1).
external_assumptions.locator: Section 3 no.13 Theorem 4, p.22; section 4 no.16 Theorem 5 and corollary, p.24
external_assumptions.read_assessment: Read the archived proposition excerpt and reuse the unchanged upstream primary reading. Applied only to line bundles on the supplied compact smooth curve. The section counts h0(L)=2 and h0(L^2)=3 remain separate imported geometric data.

external_assumptions.statement: The nilradical of a complex space has a uniform nilpotence exponent on a relatively compact subset; analytic structure sheaves are coherent and coherent sheaves are stable under the stated kernel, cokernel, image, tensor and Hom operations, including for nonreduced spaces.
external_assumptions.locator: Section 1.6 Satz 4 and proof, p.15; section 2.1 Definition 3 and properties (a)-(c), p.16
external_assumptions.read_assessment: Read the original-page text. The application to (C,O_Y/J), with nilradical I/J, gives one cofinality exponent on compact C. Coherence is also used for finite point-supported modules. Uniformity is not assumed merely from equality of zero sets.

external_assumptions.statement: For a proper holomorphic map of complex spaces and a coherent analytic sheaf on the source, every higher direct image is coherent, without a flatness hypothesis.
external_assumptions.locator: Introduction (I), p.7; section 6.5 Hauptsatz I, p.59
external_assumptions.read_assessment: Read the original-page text and inspected the p.59 raster. The unambiguous introductory source-sheaf formulation resolves the p.59 printing error. Applied to O_Y for the established proper contraction; point support then makes the coherent R1 stalk finite length.

external_assumptions.statement: For proper holomorphic pi:Y->X, coherent E, x in X and J=m_x O_Y, the m_x-adic completed stalk of R^q pi_*E is the inverse limit of (R^q pi_*(E/J^rE))_x, using ordinary ideal powers. No flatness or termwise base-change is assumed.
external_assumptions.locator: Section 6.5, definitions preceding Hauptsatz II, and Hauptsatz IIa, p.59
external_assumptions.read_assessment: Read the primary-page text and raster formula. Applied to E=O_Y. Compact infinitesimal support identifies the quotient cohomology with the direct-image stalks; explicit two-sided cofinal maps compare limits and finite length identifies the stalk with its completion.

external_assumptions.statement: The 1963 correction repairs the indicated polyradius estimates and induction arguments and withdraws closedness of the failure locus for the section 7 Satz 2 fiberwise map; it does not withdraw section 6 Hauptsatze I and IIa or add flatness.
external_assumptions.read_assessment: Read the complete archived correction and source guide. The invariant argument uses neither the withdrawn closedness assertion nor termwise base change.

external_assumptions.statement: A compact nowhere-discrete curve in a smooth complex surface with negative-definite component intersection matrix is exceptional, with proper contraction, biholomorphic complements and function descent; its reduction target is normal when the source is normal.
external_assumptions.locator: Section 4.8(e), pp.366-367; section 2.4 Definition 3, pp.339-340; section 2.1, p.337
external_assumptions.read_assessment: Read the archived primary-page reader transcription. Its application, including Hausdorff smooth source, compact C, matrix [-10], properness and normal target, is checked in the analytic-realization unit and imported here.

concrete_gaps.statement: An exact p_g would require the ranks of delta_n:H0(O_(nC))->H1(L^n) for n=2,3,4 in the actual realized neighborhood. The supported formula is p_g=39-rank(delta_2)-rank(delta_3)-rank(delta_4); only the window is claimed.
The proof gives stabilization for every n>=5, not that 5C is the earliest stable thickening. In particular surjectivity of delta_4 could make the 5C-to-4C map an isomorphism.
